graph.name: Axiom SL ControllerView Cloud Architecture
graph.notes: Axiom SL deploys automated single-tenant isolated application stacks per client environment using AMI and ECS for deployment, RDS for OLTP, RedShift for OLAP, Redshift Spectrum to query warm historical data in S3, and AWS native security/monitoring tools.

nodes.name: ECS
nodes.notes: Used for container orchestration and running application stack services per client environment.

nodes.name: AMI
nodes.notes: CIS-hardened Amazon Machine Images built for automated environment deployments.

nodes.name: KMS
nodes.notes: Provides end-to-end data encryption in transit and at rest.

nodes.name: SECURITY HUB
nodes.notes: Central security management service for monitoring compliance and security posture.

nodes.name: GUARDDUTY
nodes.notes: Intelligent threat detection service for continuous monitoring.

nodes.name: CONFIG
nodes.notes: Tracks resource configurations and automates security response to incidents.

nodes.name: CLOUDWATCH
nodes.notes: Monitors performance and triggers automated security incident responses.

nodes.name: CLOUD TRAIL
nodes.notes: Audits user activity and API calls across environments.

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Handles transactional OLTP database workloads within the application stack.

nodes.name: REDSHIFT
nodes.notes: Handles OLAP analytical data processing for regulatory reporting using RA3 nodes.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Encrypted object storage used for warm/historical data and logs.

edges.notes: Automated deployment of CIS-hardened AMI images into the client application stack.
Application stack interacts with security suite services including KMS for encryption.
CloudWatch exports monitoring and audit log data to S3 for long-term retention.
RedShift uses Spectrum to query warm historical data directly in S3.
